574-1445-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.

Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.

Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

574-1445-4871-6277.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3534-8101.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

480-6495-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.

When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.
480-6495-6981-7077.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.

Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Rilsa Rael to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.
